title: IMF Primary Commodity Price System (PCPS), monthly prices

sourceFile.format: SDMX 2.1 structure-specific XML (committed in the repository)

updateFrequency.statedAs: Primary Commodity Prices data are updated monthly based on the IMF’s Primary Commodity Prices System.

aggregationBasis.statedAs: The benchmark prices are obtained from various sources at high frequency which are then converted to monthly frequency by averaging weekly or daily values.

license.name: IMF Copyright and Usage terms (Data)
license.statedText: You may download, extract, copy, create derivative works, publish, distribute, and use Data obtained from IMF Sites, subject to the following conditions: … it must appear accurately with attribution to the IMF as the source … If the Data is materially transformed by the User, this must be stated explicitly along with the required source citation.

attribution: Source: International Monetary Fund, Primary Commodity Price System (PCPS), https://data.imf.org/en/datasets/IMF.RES:PCPS, published October 6, 2026.
changesMade: SMPT stored the IMF's published monthly values for indicators PCOBA, PPALLA and PREODOM unchanged and converted period labels from YYYY-Mmm to YYYY-MM. Percentage changes, indexed values and rankings shown with them are SMPT calculations from the IMF data, not IMF figures.
thirdPartyNote: The IMF names the London Metal Exchange (cobalt, palladium) and Shanghai Metal Market (rare-earth carbonate) as its sources. SMPT republishes only the IMF's monthly averages, not the underlying exchange or vendor data.
